headline: Last session: Nifty gained 75 points while Sensex slipped into red; smallcaps showed resilience amid volatility.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Nifty 50 managed to gain 75 points despite the Sensex slipping into the red during the last session.
Smallcap and midcap stocks showed resilience, providing support to the broader market indices.
Mixed global cues and FII activity influenced domestic sentiment as investors weighed economic data.
Stock-specific news, particularly in the energy and tech sectors, drove divergent performance across the benchmarks.
whatHappening: NTPC terminated a ₹413 crore BESS contract with GR Infraprojects due to failure in meeting obligations.
The RBI ordered the removal of a Maharashtra Minister and seven others from the Latur DCC Bank board.
Rapido filed an insolvency plea against Magicpin over alleged unpaid operational dues.
The government announced mandatory Aadhaar biometric authentication for LPG subsidies effective October 1.

summary: On the last trading day, Nifty gained 75 points while Sensex ended in the red, reflecting a mixed market sentiment.
